mapper.select: SELECT f.*, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(h.building, '-', h.unit, '-', h.room_number) AS house_info FROM fee f LEFT JOIN owner o ON f.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN house h ON f.house_id = h.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.*, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(h.building, '-', h.unit, '-', h.room_number) AS house_info FROM fee f LEFT JOIN owner o ON f.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN house h ON f.house_id = h.id WHERE f.owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee (owner_id, house_id, fee_type, amount, should_pay_date, status) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{houseId}, #{feeType}, #{amount}, #{shouldPayDate}, #{status})
